avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs (Ibuprofen, Naproxen)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal blood flow and may impair minoxidil efficacy; increased risk of sodium retention and fluid accumulation
avoid_supplements.action: Use acetaminophen for pain relief instead; if NSAIDs necessary, use lowest dose for shortest duration and monitor fluid retention

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Licorice causes sodium retention and potassium depletion, compounding minoxidil's fluid retention and hypotensive effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid licorice supplements; monitor electrolytes and blood pressure closely if concurrent use unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Potassium supplements or high-dose potassium-sparing agents
caution_supplements.mechanism: Minoxidil may cause potassium retention; excessive supplementation increases hyperkalemia risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum potassium levels; supplement only if clinically indicated with regular lab monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Caffeine supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Caffeine may potentiate tachycardia risk associated with minoxidil's vasodilation
caution_supplements.action: Limit caffeine intake to moderate levels (≤200 mg/day) and monitor heart rate and symptoms

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium foods (processed meats, canned foods, salty snacks)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Minoxidil promotes sodium and fluid retention; high dietary sodium exacerbates edema, weight gain, and blood pressure elevation
avoid_foods.action: Maintain low-sodium diet (<2.3 g/day); read food labels and choose fresh, unsalted alternatives

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Grapefruit inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing minoxidil exposure; minimal clinical impact with topical use but relevant for oral formulations
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased side effects if consuming regularly with oral minoxidil

caution_foods.name: High-potassium foods (bananas, spinach, sweet potatoes, avocado)
caution_foods.mechanism: Minoxidil may increase potassium retention; excessive dietary potassium increases hyperkalemia risk in susceptible patients
caution_foods.action: Consume moderate portions; monitor serum potassium, especially in patients with renal impairment

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and fluid retention status regularly, especially during initial therapy. Assess serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) and renal function periodically, particularly in patients with baseline hypertension or renal disease.
